name: Bridge a gap in a cut nerve
description: Span the distance between two nerve stumps so that axons have a path to grow along, without the tension that a direct suture would put on the repair.

grade.note: Autograft is the clinical standard and works. Hollow conduits match it in randomised comparison for short digital-nerve gaps (Weber 2000, Mackinnon 1990); processed allografts report comparable meaningful recovery in a multicentre registry (Safa 2020, registry not randomised). The remaining limit is gap length and donor morbidity, not whether a gap can be bridged.
grade.drift: 'Nerve gaps are solved' — short sensory gaps are; long motor gaps still depend on how fast the axons cross and what is waiting at the far end.

wouldMove: A randomised comparison in long (>3 cm) motor gaps showing an off-the-shelf conduit or allograft matching autograft on muscle function, not just sensory recovery.
